# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 32 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_004_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 4

**1** Jesus said: "The person [оуроме] old [шовс] in days will not hesitate to ask [шне] a small child [шнре кот] seven days old [сашч нехоου] about the place [маа] of life, and that person [шнре кот] will live.

**2** For many who are first [шорп] will become last [хае],

**3** and they will become a single one [оуа оуоот]."

---

**Textual Notes (EMET):**
- *оуроме шовс нехоой*: literally "a person old of days" — Semitic idiom; "old" = advanced in years
- *шнре кот сашч нехоою*: "small child of seven days" — a newborn; pre-circumcision age in Jewish custom
- *маа нохне*: "place of life"; the kingdom, the divine realm
- *шорп / хае*: first/last reversal — cf. Matt 19:30; 20:16; Mark 10:31; Luke 13:30
- *оуа оуоот*: "a single one," "one alone" — key Thomas term for the unified, undivided self; cf. Saying 22
- cf. P.Oxy 654 lines 21-27 for Greek parallel with minor variants
